question.text: If the line <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>p</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> lies completely in the plane <math><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the ordered pair <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is

solution.text:
Since the line lie in the plane, so 4,2,q also lie in the plane and vector along the line is perpendicular to normal to the plane

Therefore, 2-4+p=0⇒p=2 and 8-8+q=7⇒q=7

Hence, the ordered pair is 2,7
